# deps/

Build recipes (scripts, CMake toolchain files, patches) for the native dependencies compiled for UWP x64:
zlib, libpng, libjpeg-turbo, libwebp, freetype, harfbuzz, fribidi, SDL2, SDL2_image, FFmpeg (LGPL only), ANGLE.
Versions are pinned in docs/RESEARCH.md. Populated in milestones 1 and 3.
